description: This file defines a Position object with methods for calculating element offsets, positioning, and overlap detection, used for DOM element positioning and scrolling calculations.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes deltaX and deltaY based on current scroll offsets.

methods.name: realOffset
methods.description: Calculates the real offset of an element including scroll positions.

methods.name: cumulativeOffset
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative offset of an element relative to the document.

methods.name: positionedOffset
methods.description: Calculates the offset of an element considering its position style.

methods.name: offsetParent
methods.description: Finds the offset parent of an element.

methods.name: within
methods.description: Checks if a point (x, y) is within an element's bounds, optionally considering scroll offsets.

methods.name: withinIncludingScrolloffsets
methods.description: Checks if a point (x, y) is within an element's bounds, including scroll offsets.

methods.name: overlap
methods.description: Calculates overlap ratio in vertical or horizontal mode.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Clones the position and size of a source element onto a target element.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Calculates the page position of an element.

methods.name: absolutize
methods.description: Converts an element's position to absolute, storing original styles.

methods.name: relativize
methods.description: Reverts an element's position to relative, restoring original styles.
